atAGlance: Bún thịt nướng is rice vermicelli with lemongrass grilled pork, usually with herbs, pickles, peanuts, scallion oil, and fish-sauce dip.
whatItIs: Bún thịt nướng is a cool rice-vermicelli bowl with lemongrass grilled pork, herbs, pickles, peanuts, scallion oil, and fish-sauce dip for tossing through the noodles.
howToEnjoy: Pour the fish-sauce dip over the vermicelli little by little, then toss from the bottom so grilled pork, herbs, pickles, peanuts, and noodles mix evenly.
howLocalsOrder: Order bún thịt nướng when you want a cool noodle bowl with smoky pork. Ask for fish-sauce dip on the side or no chili if you want to control the sweet-sour fish-sauce dressing.
worthKnowing: This southern-style bowl is about contrast: warm grilled pork, cool bún, crunchy pickles, herbs, peanuts, and a bright pour of fish-sauce dip.
goodToKnow: The fish-sauce dressing is meant to season the noodles, not sit untouched on the side.
